results.title: Sincerely Saul
results.overview: Stuck at home with his bedridden Grandma, Saul plans to kill himself on his 27th birthday if he doesn't lose his virginity by then.

results.title: Sugar Baby
results.overview: Love comes without asking. Often not to those, not so and not then. Can a genuine feeling survive when everything started wrong and the whole world is against it? Give up everything or give up? Burn or survive?

results.title: 200% Wolf
results.overview: When Freddy Lupin's wayward wish transforms him into a werewolf and deposits a mischievous moon sprite on Earth, Freddy must restore the cosmic order before the earth and moon collide.

results.title: The American Society of Magical Negroes
results.original_title: The American Society of Magical Negroes
results.overview: A young man, Aren, is recruited into a secret society of magical Black people who dedicate their lives to a cause of utmost importance: making white people’s lives easier.

results.title: Literal
results.overview: Manuel lives with his father, Ricardo, on the family's hunting estate. Manu is a special boy with a strange connection to the mountains that makes him the best hunter in the area. But he no longer wants to kill. An accidental shooting that nearly kills his best friend, coupled with the suspicion that his father is a murderer, compels him to flee the estate to free himself. He soon learns that his unerring aim is the only thing that can prevent Ricardo from being killed.

results.title: Barbarian
results.overview: Her name is Barbarian, your favorite doll from childhood. She lives in Los Angeles now-Skid Row, to be exact.

results.title: Pornoway
results.overview: In 1996, brothers Danick and Pier-Luc are chilling in front of their interactive television; the Pornoway. When the pornstar on screen breaks the fourth wall to address them directly, the brothers fight to death in order to satisfy their sexual desires.

results.title: I Am: Celine Dion
results.overview: A raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar's struggle with a life-altering illness. Serving as a love letter to her fans, this inspirational documentary highlights the music that has guided her life while also showcasing the resilience of the human spirit.

results.title: China Shop
results.overview: An action comedy short inspired by Hong Kong cinema. Our protagonist, Grey, gradually fights his way through a hideout of thugs.

results.title: The Marching Band
results.overview: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

results.title: Old Guy
results.overview: Stuck at a dead end but vying for the love of spunky club manager Anata, aging contract killer Danny Dolinski is thrilled when The Company pulls him back in the field, but only to train Gen Z newcomer Wihlborg, a prodigy assassin with an attitude.

results.title: Girl Online
results.overview: A popular female vlogger realizes too late that sharing her life online has, along with some perks, terrible downsides as well. In her constant search for validation, the answer she seeks may just be by simply facing the real world head-on.

results.title: Autumn and the Black Jaguar
results.overview: Growing up in the Amazon rainforest gave Autumn the rarest of friendships – a lost jaguar cub she named Hope. When a tragic event forces her to leave Hope for New York City, she dreams of going back to the rainforest and her friend. That opportunity soon comes when Autumn decides to return to the Amazon to save her beloved jaguar from animal traffickers who threaten her childhood village.

results.title: Delivery Run
results.overview: A food delivery driver gets caught in a deadly chase in the icy Minnesota wilderness, pursued by a crazed snowplow driver for unknown reasons, facing life-threatening situations and forced to outsmart his relentless pursuer alone.

results.title: The Last Dance
results.overview: Despite the pandemic sending most industries into recession, debt-ridden wedding planner Dominic (Dayo WONG) gets a miraculous chance to turn things around when a funeral planner retires and passes the baton to him. His creative gimmicks for funerals help his business find unexpected success, but Dominic’s biggest obstacle is winning the approval of respected and sternly traditional Taoist priest, Master Man (Michael HUI). After some unordinary funerals, Dominic gradually understands Master Man’s code of ethics and the meaning behind each farewell.

results.title: Race for Glory: Audi vs. Lancia
results.original_title: Race for Glory: Audi vs. Lancia
results.overview: Inspired by true events that occurred during the fierce rivalry between Germany (Audi) and Italy (Lancia) at the 1983 Rally World Championships.

results.title: Monsters 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation
results.original_title: MONSTERS 一百三情飛龍侍極
results.overview: A samurai's path leads him to a young waitress whose hometown was destroyed by a dragon. He doesn't want any trouble — but it finds them anyway.

results.title: Afterwards
results.overview: Inside a shelter, participants in a talking circle share their experiences of intimate partner violence as a way to regain their dignity and strength to act. Powerfully empathetic, Après-coups creates a space of sisterhood and solidarity—a chorus of voices breaking down the walls of silence.
